tool.name: myloasm
tool.description: high-resolution metagenome assembly with long reads
tool.command: #set $read_files = [] #for $i, $r in enumerate($reads) #if $r.is_of_type('fastqsanger.gz') #set $ext = 'fq.gz' #elif $r.is_of_type('fastqsanger') #set $ext = 'fq' #elif $r.is_of_type('fasta.gz') #set $ext = 'fa.gz' #else #set $ext = 'fa' #end if #set $fn = 'reads_%d.%s' % ($i, $ext) ln -s '$r' '$fn' && #set $read_files = $read_files + [$fn] #end for myloasm #for $fn in $read_files '$fn' #end for --output-dir out --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --clean-dir --log-level info $preset --compression $algorithm.compression --quality-value-cutoff $algorithm.quality_value_cutoff --min-ol $algorithm.min_ol --high-freq-kmer-threshold $algorithm.high_freq_kmer_threshold #if str($algorithm.kmc): $algorithm.kmc --kmc-ram \$((\${GALAXY_MEMORY_MB:-12288} / 1024)) #end if --min-reads-contig $thresholds.min_reads_contig --singleton-coverage-threshold $thresholds.singleton_coverage_threshold --secondary-coverage-threshold $thresholds.secondary_coverage_threshold #if str($thresholds.absolute_coverage_threshold): --absolute-coverage-threshold $thresholds.absolute_coverage_threshold #end if --dereplication-ani $thresholds.dereplication_ani --dereplication-length $thresholds.dereplication_length #if $outputs_extra and 'log' in str($outputs_extra).split(','): && mv out/myloasm_*.log out/myloasm.log #end if

param.name: reads
param.label: Long reads
param.help: Nanopore R10 or PacBio HiFi reads. Multiple files are concatenated and assembled together.

param.label: Minimum estimated read identity (%)
param.help: Reads with lower identity (estimated from base qualities) are not used for graph building

param.label: Minimum overlap length for graph construction
High-frequency k-mer threshold
param.help: The most frequent 1/N k-mers are removed

param.label: Count k-mers on disk with KMC
param.help: Faster and uses less RAM than the built-in counter. Recommended for large, complex metagenomes such as soil and sediment.

param.label: Minimum number of reads per contig
Singleton contig coverage threshold
param.help: Remove single-read contigs with estimated coverage depth at or below this value

param.label: Secondary coverage threshold
param.help: Remove contigs with at most 2 reads and estimated coverage depth at or below this value

param.label: Absolute coverage threshold
param.help: Remove all contigs with estimated coverage depth at or below this value. Leave empty to disable.

param.label: Dereplication ANI (%)
param.help: Contigs with at least this ANI to a larger contig are marked as alternate

param.label: Dereplication length (bp)
param.help: Only contigs shorter than this (and > 90% aligned) are dereplicated

param.name: outputs_extra
param.label: Additional outputs
param.option: Alternate contigs (99-99.9% similar to a primary contig)
Duplicated contigs (> 99.9% similar to a primary contig)

tool.help:
**What it does**
myloasm is a de novo metagenome assembler for modern long reads. It uses polymorphic k-mers in a string-graph framework to separate closely related strains and to produce complete, often circular, contigs.
Supported data:
- Nanopore **R10** simplex reads basecalled with sup or hac (> ~97% median accuracy) - the default mode - PacBio **HiFi** reads - select *PacBio HiFi*
Older Nanopore R9 data and PacBio CLR reads are not supported.
-----
**Inputs**
One or more FASTQ/FASTA files (optionally gzipped). Multiple files are concatenated and assembled together. FASTQ input is recommended: base qualities are used to estimate read identity (see *Minimum estimated read identity*).
For large, complex metagenomes (e.g. soil, sediment), enable *Count k-mers on disk with KMC*. It is faster and uses less RAM than the built-in counter; its memory budget is set from the memory Galaxy allocates to the job.
-----
**Outputs**
- **Primary contigs** (`assembly_primary.fa`) - the polished assembly, used for most downstream analyses. - **Contig graph** (`final_contig_graph.gfa`) - the assembly graph with one node per contig, viewable in Bandage. `S` lines carry depth tags (`DP`, `DP2`, `DP3`); `a` lines record the reads making up each contig.
Optional:
- **Contig graph edges** - overlap details between contigs. - **Alternate contigs** - contigs 99–99.9% similar to, and contained in, a primary contig. - **Duplicated contigs** - contigs > 99.9% similar to, and contained in, a primary contig. - **Run log** - the detailed myloasm log.
-----
**Contig header format**
>u2658272ctg_len-2275750_circular-possibly_depth-10-9-9_duplicated-no mult=1.00
- `len` - contig length - `circular` - `yes` (single self-looping contig with > 5x depth), `possibly` (self-loop but fails a `yes` criterion) or `no` - `depth-X1-X2-X3` - estimated depth at ~99%, ~99.75% and 100% read identity - `duplicated` - `yes` (`mult` > 1.5), `possibly` (`mult` > 1.1) or `no` - `mult` - k-mer multiplicity estimate; ~1.00 for a complete prokaryotic genome, higher values may indicate merged strains or duplications
